item.title: WISPA, rural ISPs urge FCC to keep its hands off CBRS
item.description: WISPA and several rural operators have asked the FCC to refrain from relocating current users of the CBRS band. Operators have also spelled out how they're using CBRS today and outlined the risks of relocation.

item.title: 2025 in review: Taking DOCSIS to the max
item.description: While fiber is the future, DOCSIS will share the broadband spotlight for years to come. This year, cable ops have been upgrading their DOCSIS networks, and plans are underway to go beyond DOCSIS 4.0.

item.title: It's game on for 5G network slicing in Germany
item.description: Deutsche Telekom and Vodafone Germany are serving up 5G network slices for consumers and enterprises, making early moves in Europe for differentiated services.

item.title: US fiber broadband deployments hit record 11.8M in 2025 – FBA
item.description: Fiber broadband deployments reached 11.8 million US homes in 2025, a new record, for a total of 98.3 million when including homes with more than 1 passing, according to the Fiber Broadband Association (FBA). #pressrelease
